name: Coming Out On Top
source:
"Coming Out On Top" is a video game where you play a college guy who finally comes out to his best friends.  The night of your announcement, you meet a mysterious stranger who wants your number.  Of course, things aren't so simple, and it's just a matter of time before all hell breaks loose.

The story is a comedy with a touch of romance, lots of drama, and laced with erotic situations.

[From [url=http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/obscurasoft/coming-out-on-top-a-gay-dating-sim-video-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
《赢家也出柜》是一款电子游戏，你将扮演一名终于向挚友出柜的大学男生。宣布出柜的当晚，你遇见了一位神秘的陌生人，对方想要你的电话号码。当然，事情远没有这么简单，一切陷入混乱只是时间问题。

这是一部带着些许浪漫、充满戏剧性波折，并穿插情色情境的喜剧。

[摘自[url=http://www.kickstarter.com/projects/obscurasoft/coming-out-on-top-a-gay-dating-sim-video-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
